section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), a measurement instrument with two subscales (Internalisation-General and Internalisation-Athlete) used to assess appearance-ideal internalisation. The text notes that the instrument has demonstrated reliability and validity across different populations including U.S. undergraduate men, Australian community men, and U.K. gay men, but does not present data from a specific study.
